The '''Massacre at Kolanda Station''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. All [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers were massacred by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces acting on intelligence supplied by [[Krova (Hutt)|Krova]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="THH" />
